description: This Java class, MongoNamespacePersistenceOperations, provides MongoDB-based implementations of namespace persistence operations within an event sourcing context. It includes methods for purging data collections related to specific namespaces, utilizing reactive streams for asynchronous operations.

classes.name: MongoNamespacePersistenceOperations
classes.description: A final class implementing namespace persistence operations in MongoDB for event sourcing, providing methods for purging namespace data either entirely or filtered.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate MongoNamespacePersistenceOperations with a MongoDatabase and event source settings.

methods.name: purge
methods.description: Public method to initiate purging of data for a specified namespace, returning an Akka Source of throwable lists.

methods.name: selectNamespace
methods.description: Private helper that retrieves collection selections for a given namespace.

methods.name: purgeAllSelections
methods.description: Performs purging on all provided selections, merging the reactive streams for concurrent execution.

methods.name: purge
methods.description: Private method that executes the purge operation for a given selection, either dropping the collection or deleting documents based on the selection's properties.
